statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The patient has known sick sinus syndrome
The service is to correlate symptomatic events with potential arrhythmic activity or conduction abnormalities
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
SilverBridge Advantage requires pre-approval for diagnostic monitoring services
